title: Crystalsong Forest
body: Crystalsong Forest lies at the heart of Northrend, hemmed in by the Dragonblight to the south, Zul'Drak to the east, and Icecrown and the Storm Peaks to the north. Its trees are crystal from root to leaf, and its woods glitter in shades of gold and russet. In ages past night elves dwelt here at Shandaral, and the ruins of their home still stand. Their spirits have never left: lost spirits roam the western woods, and in the ruins the dead still take up arms against every intruder. In the east, strange beings steeped in magic, called the Unbound, haunt the thicket. Above the western woods floats Dalaran, and on the ground beneath it the Kirin Tor hold the Violet Stand, while servants of the blue dragonflight have dug in close by at the Azure Front. Farther east, the Silver Covenant and the Sunreavers each keep a camp of their own, facing one another across the old ruins.

title: The Violet Stand
body: The Violet Stand is the Kirin Tor's foothold on the forest floor, set among old elven ruins in the west of the woods, beneath the edge of Dalaran. Gatekeeper Melindra and Librarian Belleford are posted here. The warmages Sarina, Halister and Ilsudria stand fixed at their posts, channeling their power without rest into the shield that guards the outpost, and Warmage Yurias stands ready beside them. The guard is not for show: blue dragonkin of the nearby Azure Front prowl at the stand's very edge. A crystal here carries travelers up to the city above.

title: The Twilight Rivulet
body: The Twilight Rivulet winds through the Forlorn Woods in the shadow of floating Dalaran. It rises in the northwest at the Decrepit Flow, where ice spills down into the forest from the Ironwall Dam on the border of Icecrown, and runs south to a pool called the Mirror of Twilight. Schools of glassfin minnows dart through its clear water, and Crystalsong carrots grow wild along its banks. Dalaran's cooks send for them when the inn beneath the city runs short of food.

parts.body: Winter hyacinths grow nowhere but on the ice spilling down from the Ironwall Dam, and the Decrepit Flow is where that ice reaches the forest. Wandering bards tell of travelers who once carried these flowers to a lonely maiden at Drak'Mar Lake in the Dragonblight and were given gifts in return, and champions of the Argent Tournament in need of a blade now send for them again.

title: The Azure Front
body: Southeast of the Violet Stand, the blue dragonflight holds the Azure Front, its foothold on the ground against Dalaran and the Kirin Tor in the war Malygos wages over the world's magic. Azure manashapers labor among the crystal trees, scalebanes and spellweavers stand guard with mana-hungry beasts at their heels, and crystal wyrms circle high above. Beams of light run from tree to tree, and foci of azure crystal are set among the trunks, as though the dragons mean to draw on whatever power the forest holds.

title: The Forlorn Woods
body: The Forlorn Woods fill the western heart of the forest, their crystal boughs tinted gold and russet as if caught forever in autumn. Wolves and dappled stags roam between the trunks, grove walkers and great ancient watchers stand among the trees, and dispirited ents move among them. The lost spirits of Shandaral wander here as well, and lonely elven ruins dot the woods. Near those ruins in the center of the forest gather the unbound seers, who turn on anyone who comes too close.

title: Ruins of Shandaral
body: The Ruins of Shandaral lie in the east of the forest, between the camps of the Silver Covenant and the Sunreavers: broken walls and fallen stonework of a night elf settlement from ages past. Its people have never left. Their spirits still keep watch, warriors with shields, druids, and hunters with spectral wolves at their side, and they strike at every living intruder as though the town still needed defending. Unbound corrupters and tricksters prowl the ruins among unbound ents and dryads, and blocks of ancient elven masonry lie scattered across the ground.

title: The Unbound Thicket
body: The Unbound Thicket covers the eastern half of Crystalsong Forest. It takes its name from the Unbound who haunt it: tricksters and corrupters armed with fire and arcane curses, dryads who hurl spears, ents whose healing magic has turned corrupt, and towering ancients. Every creature of the thicket shares an affinity for magic, and each is said to hold a core of crystallized energy. Dispirited ents wander among their unbound kin, spirits of Shandaral stray out of the ruins, and trunks of crystalline heartwood lie on the thicket floor.

title: Windrunner's Overlook
body: Windrunner's Overlook is the Silver Covenant's camp in Crystalsong Forest, raised around an old elven tower on the southern edge of the Unbound Thicket. It bears the name of the Windrunners, the house of the Covenant's Ranger General, Vereesa. Scout Captain Daelin commands here. His scouts and mounted horsemen patrol the camp and the thicket around it, and Galendror Whitewing keeps the hippogryphs that carry the Covenant's riders through the north. The high elves stock a smith's supplies, food and drink, and poisons and reagents, but the Overlook is a soldiers' post first, keeping watch across the ruins toward the Sunreavers.

title: Sunreaver's Command
body: Sunreaver's Command is the camp of the Sunreavers, the blood elves who follow Archmage Aethas Sunreaver, on the northern edge of the Unbound Thicket. Like the Silver Covenant's overlook to the south, it is raised around an old elven tower, and the two camps face each other across the thicket and the Ruins of Shandaral. Scout Captain Elsia commands here. Her scouts guard the camp, mounted hawkriders keep watch, and Skymaster Baeric tends the dragonhawks that carry Sunreaver riders across the north. Sellers of food, smithing goods, poisons and reagents keep the post supplied.

title: Lord Everblaze
body: Lord Everblaze is a lord of living fire who has taken his perch on a lofty crag in the south of Crystalsong Forest, looking down over the mouth of the Crystal Vice in the Dragonblight. Fiery dancers circle him in a ring of flame, strange company among the cold crystal trees, and the height of his crag keeps him beyond the reach of anyone who cannot fly. What brought a creature of fire to this frozen forest, no one has said.

parts.body: Champions of the Argent Tournament in need of a blade have found a use for him. They send fighters up to his crag to slay him for his everburning ember, which can free a maiden encased in ice far away at Winter's Breath Lake in the Howling Fjord, the guardian of an ancient sword.
